body: بعد 6 جولات فقط أعلن التونسي نبيل معلول، المدير الفني لشباب بلوزداد الجزائري، استقالته من منصبه، اليوم السبت، عقب تعادل فريقه مع اتحاد العاصمة بنتيجة 2-2، في المباراة التي جمعتهما على ملعب 5 جويلية، ضمن منافسات الجولة السابعة من الدوري الجزائري للمحترفين، في مواجهة شهدت أحداثًا تحكيمية مثيرة وطرد مدرب الفريق. وذكرت صحيفة "الخبر" الجزائرية أن معلول أعلن استقالته رسميًا بعد 6 مباريات فقط على رأس الجهاز الفني لشباب بلوزداد، متأثرًا بنتيجة اللقاء، إلى جانب اعتراضه على قرارات الحكم الدولي مصطفى غربال، الذي أشهر البطاقة الحمراء في وجهه خلال المباراة. وشهدت المواجهة أجواء مشحونة واعتراضات متكررة على القرارات التحكيمية، بعدما احتسب غربال 3 ركلات جزاء، إلى جانب طرد لاعب اتحاد العاصمة عبادة، ومعلول بسبب احتجاجاته. وأعلن المدرب التونسي، قراره بالانسحاب خلال المؤتمر الصحفي عقب المباراة، بعدما أجاب عن أسئلة الصحفيين، دون تقديم تفاصيل إضافية بشأن أسباب رحيله. ولم يصدر شباب بلوزداد، بيانًا رسميًا، بشأن قرار مدربه حتى الآن، فيما أشارت تقارير صحفية إلى إمكانية عقد جلسة بين معلول ومسؤولي النادي لاحقا، لمناقشة قراره، وسط غموض بشأن ما إذا كانت الاستقالة نهائية أم جاءت في لحظة غضب عقب المواجهة.

body: The closure of BioWare has not come as a huge surprise. Employees at the legendary RPG studio started working on their resumes as soon as the acquisition was announced. But even if BioWare's new owners had been miscellaneous investors rather than Saudi royalty, the outlook would not have been good: This is what private equity does. Public companies are of course plenty capable of blowing things up all on their own. EA's pre-acquisition attempt to turn BioWare into a live-service shooter studio was one of the great missteps of the live service goldrush, and Microsoft's pursuit of shareholder value has led to thousands of layoffs and numerous game cancellations. body: One of the big topics of conversation around Onimusha: Way of the Sword when it released last month—and even before that, when Capcom first put out a demo of the game—was whether it was too easy. Viral clips of early game enemies standing around doing nothing gave the impression of a woefully easy game for action fans coming from the likes of Sekiro, Nioh or Ninja Gaiden. Once I played the full game, I found those fears mostly unfounded , but it's true that Onimusha's basic enemies pose little threat compared to its bosses, and mostly serve as fodder for you to cut through as you explore. Way of the Sword's harder difficulty option being locked behind beating the campaign didn't necessarily endear the game to hardcore action players, either, so I'm not shocked that one of the most popular downloads on the game's Nexusmods page is one that amps up enemy aggression . body: Arkane Lyon may soon be facing closure, according to a new report by French site Le Monde , which says a deadline to find a buyer for the studio will land on November 13, at which point Microsoft could close the studio outright. Microsoft has since extended that deadline by a month, however, so it can continue to pursue alternative options. Arkane Lyon was caught up in this year's vortex of Xbox layoffs, announced in July , which will see roughly 3,200 people put out of work. Xbox also dumped four studios: Double Fine , Compulsion Games , and Undead Labs all went independent (and almost immediately laid off large numbers of employees) while Hellblade developer Ninja Theory appears to be closing outright. Because Arkane is based in France, Xbox couldn't just drop the hammer on it. Instead, it began a legally-required consultation process "to review potential strategic options." The Le Monde report says that on July 16, 10 days after the Xbox layoffs were announced, Arkane management informed employees that Xbox intended to close the studio. body: According to hardware outlet ChannelGate , the wholesale spot prices of several RTX 50-series graphics cards are on the rise once again in China, which is an ominous indicator for consumer pricing worldwide. The 16 GB RTX 5080 is said to have increased by around 2000 CNY, which equates to around $300, while the RTX 5070 Ti has seen an increase of around 600 CNY ($90).
